Germany / Maximilianstraße, Munich

Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Kempinski München

Munich's grand hotel since 1858, on Maximilianstraße. The natural first or last night of an alpine week: arrive, settle in, and let the city set the tone before the mountains.

Plan a stay hereAbout Munich
01 / 05

In short

What to know.

  • On Maximilianstraße since 1858
  • Rooms and suites up to the presidential suites
  • The hotel's own Munich Eras programme, described below

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

A calm first night after a long flight, or a last evening in the city before flying home. From here the mountains are a short drive away the next morning.

The Munich Eras, curated by the hotel.

Three Eras designed by the hotel's Resident Curator: Royalty, Adventure and Handmade. For example, a private helicopter morning over five royal castles with the first visit of the day to Hohenschwangau Castle; a run through the English Garden with a football legend; brewing at Munich's second-smallest craft brewery.

A programme of the hotel, delivered by the hotel and its Local Insiders. We build it into your plan.

The Munich Eras: the hotel's official brochure (PDF, unmodified), published with the hotel's permission

Good to know.

The hotel stay is provided by Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Kempinski München (Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten GmbH). The Munich Eras are the hotel's programme and are reserved through the hotel. EverFlow arranges your stay; your contract is with the hotel.
